entry: First available regular Nikkei trading close strictly after the 15:30 JST publication date.
exit: Close exactly five regular Nikkei trading sessions after the entry close.
turnover_cost: one-way cost bps multiplied by absolute change in weekly position versus prior eligible observation; initial position enters from flat.
overlapping_week_rule: Weekly observations remain timestamped by publication; holiday-driven overlap is not removed post hoc.
missing_price_rule: If entry or fifth-session exit cannot be formed from the public price calendar, exclude that observation before metric calculation and report it.
